title: M1 Projection core and the default s3-projection publication option
description:
## Outcome
Papyrus has a projection library and a default "s3-projection" publication option for Markus sites: a versioned site bucket, the projector inside the content-actions Lambda, a CloudFront Function + KeyValueStore (directory index and redirects), IAM, and a config field. Publishing or saving a live item writes its page to the bucket inside the mutation.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md sections 2 (Target architecture), 4 (Code layout, API hook, concurrency), 5 (Default publication option).

## Checklist
- [ ] papyrus_content.projection: project(item_id), project_listings(), project_all(); idempotent; Markus in-process (byte-identical, plus trailing newline as the CLI)
- [ ] SiteProjector interface (item_pages, dependent_pages, static_files, redirects)
- [ ] Ordered S3 writes with x-amz-meta-papyrus-version; targeted CreateInvalidation of written paths
- [ ] publishItem / saveItem (live item) / unpublishItem call project(); response gains live, paths, url; failure returns live:false without failing the save
- [ ] Config: backend.publication { kind: "s3-projection", projector, edgeDistributionArn }; default for renderer markus
- [ ] site-backend.ts: versioned bucket (OAC-only policy), KVS + CloudFront Function, IAM (s3 put/delete on the bucket, cloudfront:CreateInvalidation), DLQ
- [ ] papyrus ops site project-all / project --items CLI (IAM)

## Acceptance
- Synth snapshot: a markus fixture site gets bucket (versioning on), function, KVS, IAM; pretext/example sites unchanged.
- In a sandbox: publish of a test item writes its page; HEAD shows papyrus-version = PublishedItem.versionNumber; mutation p50 latency recorded.
- project_all to a local directory equals today's build output for a fixture site (diff -r empty).

## Out of scope
Renditions (M2), full dependency rules for real sites (M3), cache tuning (M4), site migrations (M5, M6).

## Dependencies
Blocked by M0 spike.

## Risk
Medium: the Lambda becomes part of the publish path; keep save and projection failure separate.

## Estimate
8-12 agent-hours.

comments.text: M1 delivered. PRs: #190 (template, merged cb35371), #191 (projection core + mutation hook + ops command, merged d92a290). Release @anthusai/papyrus 1.0.0-next.44 on npm (next tag). Acceptance: (1) synth: cdk synth of pilobol-us, p-apyr-us, threat-intelligence, pretext, anth-us site.json from pre-#190 develop and current develop are byte-identical; construct synth tests (bucket versioned, OAC-only policy, KVS+function, IAM, DLQ) pass in CI. (2) Sandbox papyrus-m1-test (712236451410, now deleted): publish writes the page; HEAD x-amz-meta-papyrus-version=1 (= versionNumber), text/html, s-maxage=86400; retitle/alias/unpublish through the Lambda verified; KV redirect 301 after ~20s propagation; edge showed the edit 0.3s after invalidation. Default projector: 9 files in S3 identical to build_markus_site output (diff empty). Timings (in-Lambda, in-memory GraphQL so AppSync NOT measured; estimate 1.9-2.8s from existing baseline): default site warm edit total p50 414ms (projection 390ms incl S3 PUTs+CreateInvalidation+KVS), cold init ~700ms, billed ~1.1s. (3) project_all to a directory equals today's build: features_backend/projection.feature + pre-refactor digests; Anth.us: 117 article pages + 67 generated pages rendered by the Lambda projector (branch feature/PPY-aebfcd-anthus-projector 45d8d6a on 70328ba; no PR, main is production) byte-identical to the production-pin (c98435f) full build (2308-file manifest equal to the helper's). Anth.us projector dependent pages re-render all 67 generated pages: publish p50 3.2s in Lambda (item page alone ~46ms) - M3 narrows. Not met / caveats: mutation p50 with real AppSync not measured; default publication stays opt-in (existing sites unchanged), default-on moves to M7; image renditions are M2 (default projector rejects ::image); KVS writes need awscrt (added). Left for Ryan: status.
